requests.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production chibi animation repair, one character only. Reference shows standing, half-sitting, fully seated versions of the same whale girl (DeepSeek). Create SIX consecutive new poses of a smooth SIT DOWN between the first standing and last seated reference endpoints. Output a clean 3-column by 2-row sprite sheet, six equal square cells, transparent background, no labels or lines.
The previous animation failed because the inbetween poses went UP after already going DOWN. Every successive pose must lower the pelvis, shoulders and head monotonically while the HEAD KEEPS EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE. Do not resize the character, head or camera. Feet/toes stay on one ground line; the heels and legs bend naturally as the knees come forward and the pelvis lowers. Hands move smoothly from hanging at sides to resting on knees. Full frontal face and torso throughout, eyes fully awake. The neck stays centered between shoulders, chin/neck/chest centerline consistent. Exactly two arms/hands and two legs. Do not detach the head or squash its width.
Six frames, in chronological row-major order: 1 starts a mild knee bend, only 10% of total head drop; 2 shallow squat at 25%; 3 deeper squat at 40%; 4 low squat at 60%; 5 pelvis nearly on ground at 80%, legs fold in front; 6 almost fully seated at 95%, feet begin facing forward and hands settle near knees. Reference final seated remains the terminal keyframe after these. Crown height lowers smoothly but head dimensions remain constant. Keep the final seated design and skirt shape. No blinking, no turning head, no new props.
Preserve exact identity and rendering: dark navy thick contour, deep blue long hair with bright blue tips, whale-like side fins, scalloped white maid headband, one curl, large vivid blue eyes, navy dress with white apron and BLUE WHALE emblem, bow collar, white socks/navy shoes, blue whale tail on viewer-right. Same hair/head proportions and face as references, same crisp cel illustration style. No redesign.
All cells same drawing scale, same body center and same ground baseline, 8% margin. Target each cell 512x512, ground y470; same head width as reference proportions. Transparent actual alpha, no background, no shadow. This is a coherent full-body movement, not six unrelated illustrations.

Use case: identity-preserve. Repair ONE four-frame repeating falling animation for the exact whale-girl character in the reference. The reference is the near-end falling pose that transitions into a landing: torso facing diagonally down, head and torso connected and aligned, arms reaching forward/down, legs trail behind, blue hair and whale tail stream upwards. Preserve that coherent overall orientation in ALL FOUR FRAMES. Do NOT reset to an upright/sitting pose anywhere. Do NOT spin, turn sideways, or flip the face direction.
Output a 2-column by 2-row sprite sheet, four equal square cells, genuine transparent background, no text, grids or shadows. A subtle seamless cycle in row-major order: 1 hands extend forward, hair flows high; 2 wrists bend a little and hair tips flow to the right; 3 arms soften inward by a tiny amount, hair tips lower slightly; 4 wrists/arms and hair settle back near frame1. Frame4 must connect to frame1 with a small change. Keep torso/head orientation constant (pitch and yaw), face and shoulder axes matched, head size/crown height/body center stable. Motion is restrained arm and hair overlap only, not independent head rotation. Exactly two arms/two hands.
Preserve exact character identity: deep blue hair with cyan-blue tips, white scalloped headband, whale fins at sides, blue whale tail, dark navy dress and white apron with blue whale emblem. Head huge chibi, short limbs, same colors/outline and artwork. Keep the concerned squeezed-eyes expression from the reference throughout; mouth small worried open shape. Airborne: NO floor or support line, no impact burst or collision symbol.
Use same fixed scale and position in every cell. Entire figure visible with generous 8% transparent margin including hands and upward hair. The pose should feel like one whole body falling steadily, all variations smoothly return on looping.

processing.method: Crop/resize actual generated poses with one fixed scale per source sheet; no morphing, blending or code-drawn poses.

sit.reason: First two generated poses have overly long legs relative to the original standing endpoint; retained later poses preserve head width and monotonic height.

review.result: Monotonic seat height and stable head size; falling loop keeps whole-body pitch and joins the original landing entry. Other 22 actions retained after 25-action review.
